overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and exports dehydrated Gokhru Seed Powder derived from Tribulus Terrestris seeds. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter based in India, we supply consistent botanical ingredients to international markets. Our facility processes selected raw material through mechanical pulverization. We deliver a fine 80 to 100 mesh powder suitable for diverse industrial uses.

We follow a structured six-step manufacturing process covering sourcing, cleaning, drying, grinding, inspection, and dispatch. With moisture maintained below 7.0 percent, our powder offers uniform quality and a 24-month shelf life. We offer flexible supply options starting from a 5 Kg MOQ, supporting buyers with OEM manufacturing, custom packaging, and comprehensive export documentation.
highlights: Fine particle size of 80 to 100 mesh
Processed from selected Tribulus Terrestris seeds
Standardized Indian origin under HS Code 12119099
packaging: 5 to 10 kg bags for medium bulk orders
Custom packaging and labeling on request

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Gokhru Seed Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg for standard orders, with bulk volumes readily supported.

faqs.q: Can you provide product samples before bulk procurement?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with technical evaluation.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk supply?
faqs.a: We supply in 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label retail packaging.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and OEM services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM services, custom mesh sizes, and tailored private-label packaging to meet buyer specifications.

faqs.q: How is the product processed during manufacturing?
faqs.a: We implement a six-step process covering sourcing, sorting, drying, grinding, inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: What export documentation support do you offer?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and Certificates of Analysis with shipments.
